purpose: Derive the neutral Health selection predicate top-down, distinguish regulatory closure from experiment stipulation and anti-contamination assurance, and determine whether every necessary selection predicate is establishable without prohibited semantic inspection before any Product #14 preregistration or selector runtime change.

historical_signal.product11: Gate C not started because the v1 selector contract exposed forbidden raw locations.
historical_signal.product12: Gate C completed without selection because exact identity/currentness evidence could not be established through the frozen blind path.
historical_signal.product13: Gate C not started because the frozen selector-safe contracts could not prove the full eligibility predicate.
historical_signal.interpretation: Three consecutive experiments exposed a newly implicit selector requirement after the previous requirement was repaired. This is evidence against continued bottom-up enumeration as a convergence strategy.

regulatory_taxonomy.meaning: Necessary and sufficient only relative to the authoritative regulatory taxonomy and definitions.

experiment_population.meaning: Necessary and sufficient only relative to the population PolicyScna deliberately defines for this experiment; no regulatory force is implied.

cold_start_integrity.meaning: Anti-contamination properties are not exhaustively derivable. Assurance is earned by a frozen threat model, structural non-disclosure checks and adversarial falsification attempts.

authoritative_regulatory_findings.definition: The object is within Health Insurance Business rather than an unrelated non-life class.
authoritative_regulatory_findings.authority_basis: Insurance Act health insurance business definition and IRDAI Health Department guidance.

authoritative_regulatory_findings.definition: Issuer category is permitted to offer indemnity Health products.
authoritative_regulatory_findings.authority_basis: IRDAI states General and Health insurers may offer indemnity and/or benefit Health products; Life insurers may offer Health products only on benefit basis.

authoritative_regulatory_findings.definition: Whether the Health product is indemnity based or benefit based.
authoritative_regulatory_findings.authority_basis: IRDAI defines Health policies as indemnity based or benefit based.
authoritative_regulatory_findings.critical_finding: The public Health Insurance Products register and HLIP UIN classification do not by themselves prove indemnity. Benefit products can also be individual Health products. A separate explicit non-semantic metadata evidence path must be demonstrated before Product #14.

authoritative_regulatory_findings.definition: Whether the product is individual or group Health insurance.
authoritative_regulatory_findings.authority_basis: IRDAI expressly distinguishes individual and group Health products; its public Health Insurance Products register exposes Type Of Product values including Individual and Group.

authoritative_regulatory_findings.definition: Whether the insurance object is a product, add-on or rider.
authoritative_regulatory_findings.authority_basis: Current IRDAI Health framework treats products, add-ons and riders as distinct objects; the public product register contains explicit Add On examples and separate UIN patterns in some periods.
authoritative_regulatory_findings.critical_finding: Regulator metadata can explicitly identify some add-ons, but the public Type Of Product column is historically inconsistent and may contain New, Revision or Retail instead of object type. A generic evidence rule that proves product/add-on/rider for every selectable candidate is not yet demonstrated.

authoritative_regulatory_findings.definition: Whether an individual Health product is offered on individual-sum-insured basis, family-floater basis, or both.
authoritative_regulatory_findings.authority_basis: IRDAI recognizes individual sum-insured and family-floater arrangements and defines family floater as a shared sum insured across family members.

experiment_population_stipulations.evidence_rule: Candidate must be non-archived/current according to authorized official metadata and must not rely on product-name-only inference.
Exact product name and UIN/version must be resolved under the frozen identity/currentness contracts.
Official metadata must identify an authoritative current product document before semantic review; preselection may not inspect target clauses.
Exact product/UIN must have no prior governed semantic evidence, binding, certification fixture or prior cold-start scoring result at the frozen baseline.

required_invariants: selector receives no raw URL/path/anchor/body/screenshot fields
selector receives no target-concept presence, count, complexity or semantic-fit signals
no target clause is read before a valid selection record is frozen
no candidate is preferred or excluded because of semantic resemblance, complexity or expected runtime outcome
no selection override or manual convenience substitution is allowed
prior exposure is used only as a disqualifying cold-start integrity check, never as semantic-fit evidence

reuse_audit.finding: The bridge is partial rather than absent. Existing concepts and identity/currentness contracts should be wired where authoritative evidence supports them; no new generic subsystem is authorized by this review.

closure_outcomes.REGULATORY_TAXONOMY_COMPLETENESS_FALSIFI: A necessary regulatory classification appears outside the frozen authoritative taxonomy. Re-derive the regulatory layer; do not extend the selector ad hoc.
closure_outcomes.EXPERIMENT_POPULATION_DEFINITION_INCONSI: The stipulated experiment population is internally inconsistent or its membership rule cannot be applied as written. Revisit the PolicyScna experiment definition; no regulatory error is implied.
closure_outcomes.ANTI_CONTAMINATION_BOUNDARY_FALSIFIED: An adversarial or structural test shows prohibited information can influence selection. Harden the boundary and its threat-model tests; do not add a selector predicate.
closure_outcomes.FAIL_CLOSED_PREDICATE_EVIDENCE_PATH: A legitimate closed predicate exists but the permitted evidence path cannot establish it for a candidate. Stop rather than infer.
closure_outcomes.BLIND_SELECTION_STRUCTURAL_CEILING_PROVE: At least one necessary predicate is proven to require prohibited semantic content; strict blind neutral selection is incompatible with the population definition and Product #14 must not run.

verdict_reason: Regulatory taxonomy and experiment-population structure can be bounded, but blindness-compatible evidence paths are not yet demonstrated for at least benefit_basis, insurance_object_type and coverage_arrangement. No predicate is yet proven to require semantic content, so a structural ceiling is not yet established. Product #14 would therefore still be ambiguous if run now.
